name: paved
description: Paved engineering commands for AI coding agents: repository context, governed workflows, explicit Tools, verification and evidence, executed by a pinned project-local Paved runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Paved engineering commands for AI coding agents: repository context, governed workflows, explicit Tools, verification and evidence, executed by a pinned project-local Paved runtime.
interface.longDescription: Paved gives a repository a durable operating model for agent work. Invoke Paved commands (init, status, plan, feature, fix, refactor, test, verify, review and more) and the bundled launcher activates the version-pinned, integrity-checked Paved runtime under the repository's .paved/runtime/ directory. Workflows, Tool execution, verification and evidence are decided by that runtime; the plugin only distributes and invokes it.
defaultPrompt: Show the Paved status of this repository
